title: Implement Adagrad optimizer
description: Add Adagrad optimizer to src/optim.rs alongside existing Adam, AdamW, SGD, RMSProp. Implements adaptive learning rate per-parameter with cumulative squared gradient storage. torch.optim.Adagrad equivalent.

title: Implement label smoothing loss
description: CrossEntropyLoss with label smoothing (alpha parameter) for regularization

title: Complete all ROADMAP.md stubs for torch parity
description: Master task covering all remaining features from ROADMAP.md. Priority order: High → Medium → Low.

title: High-1: CUDA/GPU acceleration backend

title: High-2: MKL CPU support

title: High-4: Multi-threading optimizations

title: High-5: Complex number operations for RoPE

title: High-6: Sparse attention patterns

title: High-7: GeGLU and ReGLU activation variants

title: Implement Adagrad optimizer
description: Add Adagrad optimizer to src/optim.rs or src/nn/mod.rs. Formula: G += g^2, param -= lr * g / (sqrt(G) + eps)

title: Implement Lion optimizer
description: Add Lion optimizer. Formula: m = beta*m + g, u = m / (|m|+eps) * w - g, param = w - lr*u
